policy: A waiver never marks a control as technically met. Each has an owner, expiry and exit condition; tools/exit_gate.py blocks production on any BLOCKER-linked waiver and on any expired waiver. Renewal requires a new review entry in REVIEWS.json.

waivers.reason: pk_core is the suite's own framework and is not in this archive; its exact version, source URL and sha256 must be supplied by the suite owner.
waivers.exit_condition: SPEC_MANIFEST.json dependencies.pk_core.supported_versions + integrity_sha256 filled; tools/certify.py --profile certification passes in clean CI with zero skips.

waivers.reason: MASTER.md (verbatim source/master prompt) is absent and cannot be reconstructed without inventing content. Contract.py + NFR.md SHALL list are the working source of truth meanwhile.
waivers.exit_condition: Original MASTER.md recovered from the Post-Kubernetes series, committed with its sha256, and diffed against contract.py.

waivers.reason: Accountable owner recorded; on-call rotation, secondary and security contact are not yet staffed.
waivers.exit_condition: OWNERS.yaml has no TBD fields and a paging test is recorded in REVIEWS.json.

waivers.reason: Release tooling is complete, but no production Ed25519 key exists in an HSM/KMS signing service; builds are signed with ephemeral dev keys (channel dev-only).
waivers.exit_condition: KMS-backed key provisioned, public key published, a release built with it verifies via tools/release.py verify with production_eligible=true.

waivers.reason: Transport profile implemented and tested with throwaway PKI; the deployment CA, certificate issuance and rotation are platform-provided and not yet bound.
waivers.exit_condition: Deployment PKI named in KEY_MANAGEMENT.md, mTLS integration test run against it, evidence attached.

waivers.reason: CI matrix is defined but has not run; sibling layer builds (INV-41, INV-13, INV-11, PLN-03) are not available to integrate against.
waivers.exit_condition: Green CI matrix run id recorded in evidence; integration suite executed against real sibling builds.

waivers.reason: No OS/hardware protected memory in CPython; key rotation is by table replacement (destroy + new table), not in-place rekey.
waivers.exit_condition: Accepted as residual risk at next architecture review, or a native protected-memory backend is added via key_provider.

waivers.reason: Outbound licence not chosen by the owner; LICENSE records all-rights-reserved (the legal default) until then.
waivers.exit_condition: Owner selects a licence; LICENSE replaced and pyproject updated.
